# NovaDesk

> NovaDesk is a premier full-stack software engineering, AI development, and digital product studio founded by Harsh Prateek. We build high-performance web platforms, mobile applications, custom SaaS architectures, generative AI solutions, and ERP/CRM systems for startups, scaling businesses, and enterprises across India and global markets.

## Core Capabilities

- **Custom Software & SaaS Development**: Scalable cloud architectures, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, 21-day MVP launches, microservices, and enterprise automation.
- **AI & GenAI Solutions**: Custom LLM integration, autonomous support chatbots, conversational voice/text AI, RAG pipelines, and intelligent workflow automation.
- **Web & Full-Stack Engineering**: High-speed, responsive, SEO-optimized web applications built with React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and modern headless CMS platforms.
- **Mobile App Development**: Native iOS (Swift), native Android (Kotlin), and cross-platform (React Native, Flutter) mobile applications.
- **E-Commerce Systems**: High-converting digital storefronts, Shopify development, WooCommerce architectures, custom checkout flows, and payment integrations.
- **UI/UX Product Design**: Modern user interface and experience design, interactive prototypes, design systems, and conversion-focused wireframes.
- **Enterprise Software & ERP/CRM**: Business management software, inventory management, CRM pipelines, and custom enterprise tools.
- **Technical SEO & Performance**: PageSpeed optimization, WCAG accessibility, schema structured data, and organic search architecture.

- [About NovaDesk](https://www.novadesk.site/about-us): Company background, engineering philosophy, and leadership by founder Harsh Prateek.

- [Contact Us](https://www.novadesk.site/contact-us): Direct inquiry form, email, phone, and consultation booking channels.
